  {
    "testCaseId": "TC_POS_001",
    "title": "Validate successful LTE Attach and Detach for single UE under excellent radio conditions",
    "description": "Perform 10 iterations of LTE attach and detach procedure with a single UE under excellent radio conditions and verify 100% success rate and latency metrics.",
    "preconditions": [
      "Single cell LTE scenario activated and unloaded; all other cells powered off",
      "Single UE (real or emulated) placed at cell center with LTE RSRP in excellent radio conditions as per Clause 4.6",
      "Test configuration recorded",
      "End-to-end LTE setup operational without connectivity issues"
    ],
    "testSteps": [
      "Access the 5G management interface via `SSH admin@<IP>` and verify the serving cell is active and unloaded",
      "Place the UE under excellent LTE radio conditions (check LTE RSRP levels)",
      "Start logging to capture call flow and signalling messages",
      "“Power ON” the UE to initiate LTE attach procedure",
      "Wait and verify successful attach completion by validating attach request and attach complete messages in logs",
      "Measure and record attach latency from attach request to attach complete",
      "“Power OFF” the UE to initiate LTE detach procedure",
      "Wait and verify successful detach completion by validating detach request and detach accept messages and UE context release",
      "Stop and save the test logs",
      "Repeat steps 3 to 9 for total 10 iterations",
      "Calculate attach and detach success rates (expect 100%) and attach latency minimum, average, maximum"
    ],
    "expectedResults": [
      "Attach and detach procedures complete successfully in all 10 iterations",
      "Attach success rate = 100%",
      "Detach success rate = 100%",
      "Attach latency metrics (min, avg, max) recorded and within expected target KPIs",
      "UE is attached to correct LTE cell (validate PCI, Global eNB ID, ARFCN)"
    ],
    "postconditions": [
      "UE detached and test logs saved for reference"
    ],
    "commandsUsed": [
      "SSH admin@<IP>"
    ],
    "verificationMethods": [
      "Log analysis of attach/detach signalling messages",
      "Monitoring LTE RSRP values",
      "Checking UE cell attachment parameters"
    ],
    "category": "POSITIVE TESTING"
  },
